from solution import compare_versions

def test_basic():
    assert compare_versions('1.2.10', '1.2.9') == 1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0') == -1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0', '1.0.0') == 0
    assert compare_versions('2.0.0', '10.0.0') == -1

def test_spec_chain():
    chain = ['1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-alpha.1', '1.0.0-alpha.beta', '1.0.0-beta',
             '1.0.0-beta.2', '1.0.0-beta.11', '1.0.0-rc.1', '1.0.0']
    for i in range(len(chain)):
        for j in range(len(chain)):
            exp = (i > j) - (i < j)
            assert compare_versions(chain[i], chain[j]) == exp

def test_build_ignored():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0+a', '1.0.0+b') == 0
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-alpha+x', '1.0.0-alpha') == 0
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0+build-1', '1.0.0') == 0
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-rc.1+a-b', '1.0.0-rc.1+c') == 0

def test_hyphen_in_prerelease():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a-b', '1.0.0-a-c') == -1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a-b.1', '1.0.0-a-b') == 1

def test_ascii_order():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-Z', '1.0.0-a') == -1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a', '1.0.0-B') == 1

def test_numeric_vs_alpha():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-1', '1.0.0-a') == -1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a', '1.0.0-1') == 1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-99999', '1.0.0--') == -1

def test_numeric_big():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-' + '9' * 30, '1.0.0-' + '1' + '0' * 30) == -1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-2', '1.0.0-10') == -1

def test_mixed_alnum_string_compare():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-1a', '1.0.0-2') == 1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a10', '1.0.0-a9') == -1

def test_length():
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a.b.c', '1.0.0-a.b') == 1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.0-a', '1.0.0-a.0') == -1

def test_minor_patch():
    assert compare_versions('1.10.0', '1.9.9') == 1
    assert compare_versions('1.0.1', '1.0.0-zzz') == 1
    assert compare_versions('0.0.0', '0.0.1') == -1
